title: Date - date is a date, not a number of days

source.quote: if a subtraction operation uses a date with any other data type, DAX converts both values to dates, and the return value is also a date
source.supports: the Subtraction (-) table: the Date/time row is Date/time in every column, including Date/time

source.quote: the integer corresponds to the number of days since December 30, 1899
source.supports: a date as a number is the count of days since 1899-12-30

derivation: Date/time - Date/time is Date/time. The two dates are 1 day apart, and the number 1 as a date is 1 day after 1899-12-30: 1899-12-31.
notes: The table is the only source. An engine that returns the number 1 (int64 or double) here contradicts it.
